title: TikTok Ads Performance & Creative Resonance Audit

sections.executiveSummary: Summary of TikTok Business API performance, SPC campaign stability, and video hook rate dynamics.
sections.overallScore: Deterministic audit score (0-100) based on conversion efficiency, hook/hold rates, and creative fatigue.
sections.findings: Breakdown of top creative concepts, vertical 9:16 aspect compliance, and Smart Performance pacing.
sections.issues: Identified creative exhaustion (CTR decay > 30%), high CPA ad groups, and short video drop-off.
sections.recommendations: Proposals for UGC creative refreshes, Spark Ad boosting, and bidding adjustments.
sections.priorityMatrix: 4-quadrant impact matrix prioritizing rapid video testing vs budget reallocation.
sections.actionPlan: Structured execution actions for campaign optimization and creative replacement.
sections.supportingEvidence: Video view metrics (2s, 6s, 100%), hook rates, hold rates, and cost-per-conversion trends.
sections.appendix: TikTok Events API deduplication status, pixel codes, and commercial policy compliance notes.
